name: @verikit/prisma
description: Prisma ORM storage adapter for @verikit/server resources.
author: Chidi E <hi@ceeso.dev>

scripts.test: rm -rf .test-dist && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test $(find ./.test-dist/test -name '*.test.js' -type f | sort)
scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf .test-dist coverage && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='.test-dist/src/**/*.js' --test-coverage-lines=100 --test-coverage-branches=100 --test-coverage-functions=100 $(find ./.test-dist/test -name '*.test.js' -type f | sort)
